sections.title: ESG Integration in Business Practices
sections.description: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles and their significance in business practices. Students will explore the intersection of sustainability and financial performance. The course will examine the frameworks, metrics, and strategies used to assess and integrate ESG factors into business strategies. Additionally, students will analyze case studies, engage in discussions, and develop practical skills to navigate the evolving landscape of responsible business conduct.
